entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a jersey. Order number is VF-654-892.
Certainly. Let me pull that up for you. VF-654-892... I see the order for the Aero-Mesh Jersey, delivered about 54 days ago. Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. It's simply too tight. I just need to know if I can return it, yes or no.

Yes, absolutely. I'm checking the policy now... and you are well within the 90-day return period. I can process that for you right away. Would you like to do an exchange for a different size or a full refund?
An exchange is fine. Just send me the next size up.

Not a problem at all. I've just processed the exchange for the jersey in the larger size. I also see you're a VIP member, so I've gone ahead and upgraded you to complimentary express shipping. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label for the original item momentarily.
Okay, that's perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer. Have a great day!
